name: Black Dragons
description: Chinese-American criminal organization and street gang formed in the early 1980s by ethnic Chinese immigrants from Vietnam in Lincoln Heights, Los Angeles. Operated in Los Angeles and the San Gabriel Valley, involved in both organized crime (extortion, prostitution, money laundering, narcotics, counterfeiting) and street-level crime (murder, robbery, home invasion). At its peak had over 100 core members. The gang was largely dismantled after a 2003 FBI sweep that arrested over 20 members; its three leaders were convicted and sentenced to more than 24 years in prison in 2005.

sources.title: Court May Have Slain Black Dragon — Los Angeles Times (2005)
